paragraphs: MaintStar builds public works, community development, and customer relationship software suites for mid-to-large population public sector organizations. The pages describe systems purpose-built for government so they work the way a customer already works. Mobile apps that automatically sync with office systems are listed among the features.

The Public Works Suite is described as fully-configurable, single-platform, AI-powered, and cloud-based software covering horizontal and vertical assets. The Community Development Suite is GIS-enabled, updated in real-time, and managed from highly configurable dashboards. A public portal lets residents and businesses report a broken streetlight, pay a business license fee, and check the status of a building permit from the same login and interface.
The suites and modules are built to integrate with each other at the native code level. Implementation services are performed solely by MaintStar employees rather than a third party consultant.
